name: rls-edge-guard
displayName: RLS & Edge Guard for Supabase + Workers
description: Blocks insecure Supabase Row-Level Security SQL, leaked service-role keys, and Cloudflare Workers-incompatible code as Claude writes it. Hooks run after file edits, before Supabase MCP migrations, and before supabase db push / wrangler deploy, but only act in projects with a supabase/ directory, a Supabase client dependency, or a wrangler config. Local Python only: no network calls, no telemetry, no installs. Includes skills to author RLS policies, prove them with pgTAP, and port Node APIs to Workers.
